lines.gurmukhi: ਤੀਜੈ ਮੁਹੀ ਗਿਰਾਹ ਭੁਖ ਤਿਖਾ ਦੁਇ ਭਉਕੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: teejai muhee giraah bhukh tikhaa dui bhaukeeaa ||
lines.translation: In the third watch, both hunger and thirst bark for attention, and food is put into the mouth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਾਧਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਆਹ ਭੀ ਖਾਣੇ ਸਿਉ ਦੋਸਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: khaadhaa hoi suaah bhee khaane siu dosatee ||
lines.translation: That which is eaten becomes dust, but they are still attached to eating.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਉਥੈ ਆਈ ਊਂਘ ਅਖੀ ਮੀਟਿ ਪਵਾਰਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: chauthai aaee oo(n)gh akhee meet pavaar gaiaa ||
lines.translation: In the fourth watch, they become drowsy. They close their eyes and begin to dream.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੀ ਉਠਿ ਰਚਿਓਨੁ ਵਾਦੁ ਸੈ ਵਰੑਿਆ ਕੀ ਪਿੜ ਬਧੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhee uth rachion vaad sai varhiaa kee piR badhee ||
lines.translation: Rising up again, they engage in conflicts; they set the stage as if they will live for 100 years.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਵੇਲਾ ਵਖਤ ਸਭਿ ਜੇ ਅਠੀ ਭਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhe velaa vakhat sabh je athee bhau hoi ||
lines.translation: If at all times, at each and every moment, they live in the fear of God

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saahib man vasai sachaa naavan hoi ||1||
lines.translation: -O Nanak, the Lord dwells within their minds, and their cleansing bath is true. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 2 ||
lines.translation: Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਹ ਜਿਨੀ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: seee poore saah jinee pooraa paaiaa ||
lines.translation: They are the perfect kings, who have found the Perfect Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਠੀ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹ ਰਹਨਿ ਇਕਤੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: athee veparavaah rahan ikatai ra(n)g ||
lines.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, they remain unconcerned, imbued with the Love of the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਥਾਹ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: darasan roop athaah virale paaeeahi ||
lines.translation: Only a few obtain the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the Unimaginably Beauteous Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਬੋਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: karam poorai pooraa guroo pooraa jaa kaa bol ||
lines.translation: Through the perfect karma of good deeds, one meets the Perfect Guru, whose speech is perfect.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਘਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੋਲੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak pooraa je kare ghatai naahee tol ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, when the Guru makes one perfect, one's weight does not decrease. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਰਿ ਮੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa too(n) taa kiaa hor mai sach sunaaeeai ||
lines.translation: When You are with me, what more could I want? I speak only the Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਠੀ ਧੰਧੈ ਚੋਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: muthee dha(n)dhai chor mahal na paaeeai ||
lines.translation: Plundered by the thieves of worldly affairs, she does not obtain the Mansion of His Presence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਨੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਠੋਰਿ ਸੇਵ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: enai chit kathor sev gavaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Being so stone-hearted, she has lost her chance to serve the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ਸੁ ਭੰਨਿ ਘੜਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit ghat sach na paai s bha(n)n ghaRaaeeai ||
lines.translation: That heart, in which the True Lord is not found, should be torn down and re-built.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਵਟਿ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੁਲਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiu kar poorai vat tol tulaaeeai ||
lines.translation: How can she be weighed accurately, upon the scale of perfection?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਆਖੈ ਘਟਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: koi na aakhai ghat haumai jaaeeai ||
lines.translation: No one will say that her weight has been shorted, if she rids herself of egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਈਅਨਿ ਖਰੇ ਪਰਖਿ ਦਰਿ ਬੀਨਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: laeean khare parakh dar beenaaeeai ||
lines.translation: The genuine are assayed, and accepted in the Court of the All-knowing Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਉਦਾ ਇਕਤੁ ਹਟਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: saudaa ikat hat poorai gur paaeeai ||17||
lines.translation: The genuine merchandise is found only in one shop-it is obtained from the Perfect Guru. ||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 2 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਠੀ ਪਹਰੀ ਅਠ ਖੰਡ ਨਾਵਾ ਖੰਡੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: athee paharee ath kha(n)d naavaa kha(n)d sareer ||
lines.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, destroy the eight things, and in the ninth place, conquer the body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਭਾਲਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis vich nau nidh naam ek bhaalahi gunee gaheer ||
lines.translation: Within the body are the nine treasures of the Name of the Lord-seek the depths of these virtues.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਵੰਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੀਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: karamava(n)tee saalaahiaa naanak kar gur peer ||
lines.translation: Those blessed with the karma of good actions praise the Lord. O Nanak, they make the Guru their spiritual teacher.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰਿ ਸਬਾਹ ਕੈ ਸੁਰਤਿਆ ਉਪਜੈ ਚਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: chauthai pahar sabaah kai suratiaa upajai chaau ||
lines.translation: In the fourth watch of the early morning hours, a longing arises in their higher consciousness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਾ ਦਰੀਆਵਾ ਸਿਉ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tinaa dareeaavaa siu dosatee man mukh sachaa naau ||
lines.translation: They are attuned to the river of life; the True Name is in their minds and on their lips.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਥੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੰਡੀਐ ਕਰਮੀ ਹੋਇ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: othai a(n)mrit va(n)deeai karamee hoi pasaau ||
lines.translation: The Ambrosial Nectar is distributed, and those with good karma receive this gift.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਸੀਐ ਵੰਨੀ ਚੜੈ ਚੜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ka(n)chan kaaiaa kaseeai va(n)nee chaRai chaRaau ||
lines.translation: Their bodies become golden, and take on the color of spirituality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਸਰਾਫ ਕੀ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਤਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: je hovai nadar saraaph kee bahuR na paaee taau ||
lines.translation: If the Jeweller casts His Glance of Grace, they are not placed in the fire again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤੀ ਪਹਰੀ ਸਤੁ ਭਲਾ ਬਹੀਐ ਪੜਿਆ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: satee paharee sat bhalaa baheeai paRiaa paas ||
lines.translation: Throughout the other seven watches of the day, it is good to speak the Truth, and sit with the spiritually wise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਥੈ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਕੂੜੈ ਘਟੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: othai paap pu(n)n beechaareeai kooRai ghatai raas ||
lines.translation: There, vice and virtue are distinguished, and the capital of falsehood is decreased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਥੈ ਖੋਟੇ ਸਟੀਅਹਿ ਖਰੇ ਕੀਚਹਿ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: othai khote sateeahi khare keechahi saabaas ||
lines.translation: There, the counterfeit are cast aside, and the genuine are cheered.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਣੁ ਫਾਦਲੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਖਸਮੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bolan phaadal naanakaa dukh sukh khasamai paas ||1||
lines.translation: Speech is vain and useless. O Nanak, pain and pleasure are in the power of our Lord and Master. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 2 ||
lines.translation: Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉਣੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਧਰਤਿ ਮਹਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: paun guroo paanee pitaa maataa dharat mahat ||
lines.translation: Air is the Guru, Water is the Father, and Earth is the Great Mother of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਦਾਈ ਦਾਇਆ ਖੇਲੈ ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: dinas raat dui daaee daaiaa khelai sagal jagat ||
lines.translation: Day and night are the two nurses, in whose lap all the world is at play.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਆ ਵਾਚੇ ਧਰਮੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: cha(n)giaaeeaa buriaaeeaa vaache dharam hadoor ||
lines.translation: Good deeds and bad deeds-the record is read out in the Presence of the Lord of Dharma.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੀ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣੀ ਕੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਕੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: karamee aapo aapanee ke neRai ke door ||
lines.translation: According to their own actions, some are drawn closer, and some are driven farther away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗਏ ਮਸਕਤਿ ਘਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee naam dhiaaiaa gae masakat ghaal ||
lines.translation: Those who have meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and departed after having worked by the sweat of their brow

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਹੋਰ ਕੇਤੀ ਛੁਟੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak te mukh ujale hor ketee chhutee naal ||2||
lines.translation: -O Nanak, their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord, and many others are saved along with them! ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਸਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa bhojan bhaau satigur dasiaa ||
lines.translation: The True Food is the Love of the Lord; the True Guru has spoken.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਪਤੀਆਇ ਸਚਿ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sache hee pateeaai sach vigasiaa ||
lines.translation: With this True Food, I am satisfied, and with the Truth, I am delighted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਕੋਟਿ ਗਿਰਾਂਇ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachai kot giraa(n)i nij ghar vasiaa ||
lines.translation: True are the cities and the villages, where one abides in the True Home of the self.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਨਾਉ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਰਹਸਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur tuthai naau prem rahasiaa ||
lines.translation: When the True Guru is pleased, one receives the Lord's Name, and blossoms forth in His Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਦੈ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ ਕੂੜਿ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachai dai deebaan kooR na jaaeeai ||
lines.translation: No one enters the Court of the True Lord through falsehood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੋ ਝੂਠੁ ਵਖਾਣਿ ਸੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਖੁਆਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jhootho jhooth vakhaan s mahal khuaaeeai ||
lines.translation: By uttering falsehood and only falsehood, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is lost.
